_about: Suggested names for the ixitic atlas's unnamed shapes (ixoic_suggest.py), keyed by atlas name.

sagypsobtady.why: Suggested from its ixoic twin 01f5277e9331 (the same polychoron), suggested Phigypsobted (Phi Gyroprismatic Snub Bitetrahedral 240): the list names each ixoic snub bitetrahedral 240 that is also ixitic with a twin Dis120 (Sagypsobted / Sagypsobtady, Gypsobted / Gypsobtady, Awosbited / Awosbitdy, ...).
